text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: —I ain't aimin' for nothin' right now.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Well, turns out it ain't the time to decide yet.
Our plan remains up in the air, yeah.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ehh?! ☆ What the heck!
You're doing the exact same thing as me?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: …………Liar.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Even though you have things you want to do,
and you're actually able to do them.

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, did you see?
Nakayama-san's Satsuki Sho interview!

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
I saw it! Wasn't it like, 'Don't you dare give up on your own~'?! 
So cool~~!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"We might as well chase that dream together.
If it's romance you're after, floating a little off the ground without keeping both feet down is just about right."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
“Now, look toward hope.
—In the next Derby.”

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Aha, whoa.
Did you really say this in front of everyone,
Nakayama?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I mean, what hope?
Everyone around us is saying it's impossible.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Because—

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text: No, you can't, Tosen Jordan-san.

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text: The way this hoof is cracked cannot be overlooked. It's unfortunate, but she should sit out races during the Classic year.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"...Tosen Jordan.
Getting injured at a time like this. How tragic."

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
It felt like I was close to getting results, though.
Still, by the end of this year—

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: —There's no way.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...! If everyone around you says it's impossible, then it just is, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, let's go watch
the Derby together!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, gotta study up!
One of these days, I'm gonna run in the Derby~!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Ghhh.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
—Annoying. So annoying.
Annoying, annoying, ANNOYING...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"I don't even have any goals
or hope left...!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...In a situation like this...!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And now, the Japanese Derby will soon begin!
The once-a-year festival of Umamusume raises its curtains!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...If you say you can show me a dream,
then show me...!
—The 'Japanese Derby'.

The 2,400-meter turf race, said to hold the longest history
among the Classic Triple Crown route races.
A pinnacle that every young racer strives to reach.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Well now, the Triple Crown trail is already at its halfway point.
Derby Day is finally here.
choice_data_list: Let's show the world what you're made of.
Let's show the world what you're made of.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
You're right. What we need to do
lies right before our eyes.
choice_data_list: If you become a Derby Umamusume, your talent will be recognized.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Exactly.
...Or at least, that was the plan.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Trainer, did you see that?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"...Just what the public's sayin' about it.
Well, keep it in mind as info, alright?"

If we're talking about rumors,
it's probably regarding that article featured the other day.

text_block_list.name: Magazine Article
text_block_list.text:
—"Special Feature on Umamusume Taking on the World:
The Oaks Umamusume Steps Forward"

text_block_list.name: Magazine Article
text_block_list.text: "Does her fierce ambition surpass even the future Derby Umamusume?! All eyes should be on the Tiara route right now!"

An unanticipated torrent of the era.
Yet the die has already been cast.

And this is a game I started to win.
I have no intention whatsoever of pulling my bets back now.
—The second leg of the Classic Triple Crown route, the Japanese Derby, begins.
